entities.name: Chen Xiaoli
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chen Xiaoli is a female Chinese basketball player who was part of the teams that won gold medals at the 2002 Asian Games, the 2006 Asian Games, and the 2010 Asian Games. She competed at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing and the 2012 Summer Olympics in London.
